title: Amul (GCMMF statement, 11 Nov 2026) raises fresh pouch milk prices from Thu 12 Nov: Gold (6% fat) +₹4 a litre (about 5.5%), Taaza (3% fat) +₹2 (about 3.3%); GCMMF cites costlier cattle feed, fodder, packaging film and fuel and low, uneven rain, says member unions raised farmer procurement prices 4–5% in a year and its 36 lakh producers get about 80% of what consumers pay. Mother Dairy (statement via ANI, 11 Nov; same rates reported earlier by PTI citing sources) raises Delhi-NCR prices the same day: full cream ₹72→₹76, toned ₹60→₹62, double toned ₹54→₹56, cow ₹62→₹65. Both last raised prices by ₹2 on 14 May 2026
